observation.evaluation:
Correctness: PARTIALLY_CORRECT  
Safety: CAUTION  
Issues: Image 1 is only a lateral radiograph; the “L” marker indicates a left lateral projection, not the side of the atelectasis. Basilar opacity/atelectasis may be present, but right-versus-left laterality cannot be reliably confirmed from this single view; the risk text also notes conflicting model outputs.  
Suggestion: Confirm laterality with the frontal radiograph/report or CT before accepting “right base” over “left base.”
